name: adh-frida-hooks
description: ADH Frida hook bundler cache (esbuild + language bridges). Frida 17+ no longer bundles the Java/ObjC bridges inside the Gadget runtime, so hooks that call Java.perform() must be bundled with frida-java-bridge. `buffer` is declared explicitly because frida-java-bridge/lib/mkdex.js imports it without declaring it: an undeclared copy made bundling work by luck until an npm install pruned it.
